remarks.para: CubeProgrammerApi is a class wrapper around a native ST CubeProgrammer_API library for connecting to ST-LINK and bootloader interfaces, managing loaders and option bytes, reading/writing/verifying device memory, and handling device-specific features with interop marshalling and safe disposal.

GetStLinkList.summary: This method allows to get ST-LINK connected probe(s).
GetStLinkList.param: Enable shared mode allowing connection of two or more instances to the same ST-LINK probe.
GetStLinkList.returns: This method returns a list of connected ST-LINK probes and its default configurations.

remarks.para: The Share option is useful only with ST-LINK Server. At the end of usage, DeleteInterfaceList must have been called.

GetStLinkEnumerationList.summary: This method allows to get ST-LINK connected probe(s) without connecting and intruse the target.
GetStLinkEnumerationList.param: Enable shared mode allowing connection of two or more instances to the same ST-LINK probe.
GetStLinkEnumerationList.returns: This method returns a list of connected ST-LINK probes and its default configurations.

remarks.para: The Share option is useful only with ST-LINK Server. At the end of usage, DeleteInterfaceList must have been called.

ConnectStLink.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through SWD or JTAG interfaces.
ConnectStLink.param: Indicates customized configuration for ST-LINK connection.

remarks.para: It is recommended to check fields before connection.

Reset.summary: This method used to apply a target reset.

remarks.para: Reset operation is only available with JTAG/SWD debug interface.

GetUsartList.summary: This method allows to get the list of available USART interfaces.
GetUsartList.returns: This method returns a list of available USART interfaces.

ConnectUsartBootloader.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through USART interface.
ConnectUsartBootloader.param: Indicates customized configuration for USART connection.

SendByteUart.summary: This method allows to send a single byte through the USART interface.
SendByteUart.param: Indicates the data to be written.

GetDfuDeviceList.summary: This method allows to get the list of connected DFU devices.
GetDfuDeviceList.param: Indicate the Product ID to be used for DFU interface (0xdf11).
Indicate the Vendor ID to be used for DFU interface (0x0483).
GetDfuDeviceList.returns: This method returns a list of available Dfu devices.

remarks.para: At the end of usage, DeleteInterfaceList must have been called.

ConnectDfuBootloader.summary: This method allows to start a simple connection through USB DFU interface.
ConnectDfuBootloader.param: Indicates the index of DFU ports already connected.

ConnectDfuBootloader2.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through USB DFU interface.

remarks.para: It's recommanded to use this method to disable readout protection when connecting a MCU based device.

ConnectDfuBootloader2Overload.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through USB DFU interface.
ConnectDfuBootloader2Overload.param: Indicates the index of DFU ports already connected.
Request a read unprotect: value in {0,1}.
Request a TZEN regression: value in {0,1}.

remarks.para: It's recommanded to use this method to disable readout protection when connecting a MCU based device.

ConnectSpiBootloader.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through SPI interface.
ConnectSpiBootloader.param: Indicates customized configuration for SPI connection.

ConnectCanBootloader.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through CAN interface.
ConnectCanBootloader.param: Indicates customized configuration for CAN connection.

remarks.para: To have CAN full support, you must have St-Link firmware version at least v3JxMxB2.

ConnectI2CBootloader.summary: This method allows to start connection to device through I2C interface.
ConnectI2CBootloader.param: Indicates customized configuration for I2C connection.

SetDisplayCallbacksOverload.summary: This method allows to choose your custom display. Fill the parameters to customize the display tool.
SetDisplayCallbacksOverload.param: Display internal messages according to verbosity level.
Display the loading of read/write process.

remarks.para: This method must be called first of all to ensure the display management.

SetDisplayCallbacks.summary: This method allows to choose your custom display.
SetDisplayCallbacks.param: Fill the struct to customize the display tool.

remarks.para: This method must be called first of all to ensure the display management.

SetVerbosityLevel.summary: This method allows to choose the verbosity level for display.

CheckDeviceConnection.summary: This method allows to check connection status [maintained or lost].
CheckDeviceConnection.returns: TRUE if the device is already connected, otherwise the connection to device is lost.

GetDeviceGeneralInf.summary: This method allows to get general device information.
GetDeviceGeneralInf.returns: This method returns structure in which the informations are stored.

ReadMemory.summary: This method allows to receive memory data on the used interface with the configration already initialized.
ReadMemory.param: The address to start reading from.
The number of bytes to read.
ReadMemory.returns: This method returns a tuple containing the and the data buffer.

remarks.para: Unlike ST-LINK interface, the Bootloader interface can access only to some specific memory regions.

WriteMemory.summary: This method allows to write memory data on the used interface with the configuration already initialized.
WriteMemory.param: The address to start writing from.
The number of bytes to write if smaller from the data length.

remarks.para: Unlike ST-LINK interface, the Bootloader interface can access only to some specific memory regions.

WriteMemoryAutoFill.summary:
This method allows to write memory data on the used interface with the configuration already initialized.
Aligns the buffer to a multiple of 8 bytes appending 0xFF if necessary.
WriteMemoryAutoFill.param: The address to start writing from.
The number of bytes to write if smaller from the data length.

remarks.para: WARNING: This method is not recommended for large data sizes, as it may lead to performance issues. It is advisable to use the WriteMemory method followed by a separate verification step for larger data transfers.
WARNING: This method does not reference an official function from the CubeProgrammer_API library!

WriteMemoryAndVerify.summary:
This method allows to write memory data and verify on the user interface with the configuration already initialized.
Aligns the buffer to a multiple of 8 bytes appending 0xFF if necessary.
WriteMemoryAndVerify.param: The address to start writing from.
The number of bytes to write if smaller from the data length.

remarks.para: WARNING: This method is not recommended for large data sizes, as it may lead to performance issues. It is advisable to use the WriteMemory method followed by a separate verification step for larger data transfers.
WARNING: This method does not reference an official function from the CubeProgrammer_API library!

EditSector.summary: This method allows to write sector data on the user interface with the configuration already initialized.
EditSector.param: The address to start writing from.
The number of bytes to write if smaller than the data length.

remarks.para: Unlike ST-LINK interface, the Bootloader interface can access only to some specific memory regions.
Data size should not exceed sector size.

DownloadFile.summary:
This method allows to download data from a file to the memory.
File formats that are supported :
hex Is an ASCII text file that stores binary machine code and memory addresses using hexadecimal numbers.
bin Is a data archive saved in binary code, not directly readable as text.
binary Is a data archive saved in binary code, not directly readable as text.
srec Motorola S-record.
s19 Motorola S-record.
tsv Flash Layout Files (Tab-Separated Values).
elf Executable and Linkable Format.
axf Executable and Linkable Format (ARM Executable file).
out Executable and Linkable Format.
stm32 Is a binary file format that contains a special STMicroelectronics header.
DownloadFile.param: Indicates the full path of the considered file.
The address to start downloading from.
In case to win in term time and if we have a blank device, we can skip erasing memory before programming [skipErase=0].
To add verification step after downloading.

Execute.summary: This method allows to run the application.
Execute.param: The address to start executing from.

remarks.para: In most cases, the program will run from the Flash memory starting from 0x08000000.

MassErase.summary: This method allows to erase the whole Flash memory.
MassErase.param: The name of the Flash memory to be erased.

remarks.para: Depending on the device, this method can take a particular period of time.

SectorErase.summary: This method allows to erase specific sectors of the Flash memory.
SectorErase.param: Indicates the indexs of the specific sectors to be erased.
The name of the Flash memory to be erased.

remarks.para: Each circuit has a specific number of Flash memory sectors.

ReadUnprotect.summary: This method allows to disable the readout protection.

remarks.para: If the memory is not protected, a message appears to indicate that the device is not under Readout protection and the command has no effects.
Depending on the device used, this method take a specific time.

TzenRegression.summary: This method allows to perform the TZEN Option Byte regression.

remarks.para: Depending on the device used, this method take a specific time.

GetTargetInterfaceType.summary: This method allows to know the interface that is in use.

GetCancelPointer.summary: This method allows to drop the current read/write operation.
GetCancelPointer.returns: 0 if there is no call for stop operation, otherwise 1.

FileOpen.summary: This method allows to open and get data from any supported file extension.
FileOpen.param: Indicates the full path of the considered file.

remarks.para: WARNING: This method does not reference an official function from the CubeProgrammer_API library!

FileOpenAsPointer.summary: This method allows to open and get a pointer from any supported file extension.
FileOpenAsPointer.param: Indicates the full path of the considered file.
FileOpenAsPointer.returns: Pointer to if the file has hex, bin, srec or elf as extension, otherwise a null pointer to indicate that the file type is not supported.

FreeFileData.summary: This method allows to clean up the handled file data.
FreeFileData.param: Pointer to the file data to be freed.

FreeLibraryMemory.summary: This method allows to free a specific memory region, typically used after readMemory().

remarks.para: It's crucial to ensure that the data is no longer in use after you free the memory.

Verify.summary: This method allows to verify if the indicated file data is identical to Flash memory content.
Verify.param: Pointer to the file data to be verified.
The address to start verifying from, it's considered only if the file has .bin or .binary as extension.

VerifyMemory.summary: This method allows to verify if the indicated memory data is identical to Flash memory content.
VerifyMemory.param: The address to start verifying from.

remarks.para: WARNING: This method does not reference an official function from the CubeProgrammer_API library!

VerifyMemoryBySegment.summary: This method allows to verify if the indicated memory data is identical to Flash memory content.
VerifyMemoryBySegment.param: The address to start verifying from.

remarks.para: WARNING: This method does not reference an official function from the CubeProgrammer_API library!

SaveFileToFile.summary: This method allows to save the data file content to another file.
SaveFileToFile.param: Pointer to the file data to be saved (Input file name.).
The name of the file to save the data to (Output file name.).

SaveMemoryToFile.summary: This method allows to save Flash memory content to a file.
SaveMemoryToFile.param: The address to start saving from.
The size of the data to save.
The name of the file to save the data to.

remarks.para: The file name must finish with an extension ".hex", ".bin" or ".srec".

Disconnect.summary: This method allows to clean up and disconnect the current connected target.

remarks.para: This method disconnect the target and delete the loaded Flash Loaders.

DeleteInterfaceList.summary: This method allows to clear the list of each created interface.

remarks.para: The list is filled by , , .

AutomaticMode.summary: This method allows to enter and make an automatic process for memory management through JTAG/SWD, UART, DFU, SPI, CAN and I²C interfaces.
AutomaticMode.param: The address to start downloading from.
If we have a blank device, we can skip erasing memory before programming [skipErase=0].
Indicates the option bytes commands to be loaded "-ob [optionbyte=value] [optionbyte=value]..."

remarks.para: Connection to target must be established before performing automatic mode.

SerialNumberingAutomaticMode.summary: This method allows to enter and make an automatic process for memory management with serial numbering through JTAG/SWD, UART, DFU, SPI, CAN and I²C interfaces.
SerialNumberingAutomaticMode.param: The address to start downloading from.
If we have a blank device, we can skip erasing memory before programming [skipErase=0].
Indicates the option bytes commands to be loaded "-ob [optionbyte=value] [optionbyte=value]..."
The address where the inital data and the subsequent increments will be made.
Intial data used for the serial numbering that will be incremented.

remarks.para: Connection to target must be established before performing automatic mode with serial numbering.

GetStorageStructure.summary: This method allows to get Flash storage information.
GetStorageStructure.returns: A tuple containing the and the storage structure.
